newsitem.title: UK: National Home Loans buys loan portfolio.
newsitem.headline: National Home Loans buys loan portfolio.

text.p: National Home Loans Holdings Plc said on Monday it had conditionally agreed to buy a residential mortgage loan portfolio from an undisclosed UK bank subsidiary for about 44 million stg.
The residential mortgage company said it would pay cash under the deal.
National Home's statement said the price represented a discount to the book value of the assets.
It expected to have completed the transaction on October 28.
The company said the deal was the third acquisition it had made since its successful capital reconstruction and rights issue in February 1995.
